artifact: the four 05 Sleep Vs Death LEAD-FILL promotions: 0baae2d3c3398e49, ebac804153a7b6ba, e24bc5115516a589, 90fca6fa327f321c
was: each promoted best_validated_so_far, gate verdict REVIEW
why_retracted: all four receipts carry "preservation": "FAIL" beside "promotion": "PROMOTED". They reached BEST through the same hole that promoted the 04 octave copy: in compare_checkpoint the Tier 1 preservation and Tier 1b position tests sat inside the relative branch, the one that runs when the CHECKPOINT itself fails. Against a PASSING checkpoint the only test was the candidate's own verdict, and REVIEW is not FAIL, so a build that lost or invented a pitch promoted with the Tier 1 result printed and ignored.
how_it_was_found: swept every RECEIPTS.jsonl under ~/Projects/_outputs/theship-tabs/ for the pair preservation FAIL + promotion PROMOTED. 9 receipt files scanned, 6 hits: 2 on 04 Six Feet Under and 4 on 05 Sleep Vs Death. One further receipt, 11-ambulance-BASELINE, carries preservation NOT_RUN + PROMOTED and is recorded rather than retracted, since an unrun gate on a seeding entry is a different case.
the_related_measurement: 05 Sleep Vs Death-LEAD-FILL.gp reads 20.5% octave copy on the Lead staff under octave_copy_gate.py, from the same fret+12 lead-fill technique that produced the 04 fraud at 77.4%. It sits under the gate's 50% threshold so the new gate passes it, and it is the same class of content.
what_survives: nothing about the 05 measurements is contradicted. The retraction is about how these builds acquired the word BEST, not about any number printed in them.
file_kept: every build stays on disk, unpromoted. Nothing deleted.
durable_fix: impossible_gate.py compare_checkpoint patched 2026-08-16: preservation_ok is False and position_ok is False are now refusals in ABSOLUTE mode as well as RELATIVE. Verified against the real 04 files, checkpoint PASS and candidate REVIEW, where preservation FAIL now returns replace=False and previously returned replace=True. The skill's regression suite reads 6 PASS / 1 XFAIL / 3 FAIL both before and after the patch, so the three failures are pre-existing open defects rather than breakage.
